title: Certificate battery for: Lattice Green's function of the hyperkagome lattice: modular uniformization at level 30 from an orthogonal differential Galois group
description:
Machine-checked certificates, exact-arithmetic scripts and data accompanying the paper “Lattice Green's function of the hyperkagome lattice: modular uniformization at level 30 from an orthogonal differential Galois group”.

The lattice Green's function of the hyperkagome lattice, the iridium sublattice of Na4Ir3O8, was reduced by Varma and Monien (Phys. Rev. E 87, 032109, 2013) to a threefold integral they found no way to solve exactly. This repository certifies the third-order Picard–Fuchs operator that annihilates it, its orthogonal differential Galois group, the order-two intertwiner making it projectively a symmetric square, and the uniformization of the genus-zero modular curve of the level-30 Fricke group by the underlying second-order operator, together with the explicit weight-two depth-one quasimodular period.

Nineteen scripts run on a plain Python installation with NumPy, SciPy, SymPy and mpmath. No computer-algebra licence and no SageMath are required. Each script validates its own primitives on operators of known structure, and carries negative controls, before the certified computation, and exits zero. Five scripts write their CERTIFICATE file themselves; the remaining certificate files are the captured standard output of the script of the same name.
